translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Bwasa sola Ruti ivaisi

Bwasa ilokaia mapilana ambaisa tomota si kabosigugula opapala kalapisilela valu, e isili baisa. E oluvi matauna vaiyola Elimeleki ililoula ima. E Bwasa idou kawala, “Sogu, kuma kusili baisa.” E matauna ila isili.
E tuvaila Bwasa idou matausina kaidadala valu kasitailuwotala bimaisi isigugulasi deli. Bogwa isilaisi,
e Bwasa iluki matauna vaiyola, kawala, “Ka, minana Naomi ikaimilavau metoya Mowabi, e magila bigimoli kwabila makubilana veiyoda Elimeleki la kwabila.

E yeigu adoki ibodi bukunikoli baisa. Mapaila kidamwa magim, kumapu wala baisa tuta omitasi matausina kaidadala valu. E kidamwa gala magim, kulivala makawala, paila yoku ibodaim bukumapubogwa oluviga yeigu.” Matauna tau ikaibiga, kawala, “Bogwa bamapu.”

Bwasa ikaibiga, kawala, “Saina bwaina. Mitaga kidamwa bukumapu kwabila metoya baisa Naomi, deli wala bukumapugugoli minana Ruti nakakau vilela Mowabi, kidamwa kwabila makubilana bisisu kasi bigukeya matausina tokwaliga veyala.”
E matauna vaiyola Elimeleki ivitakauloki, kawala, “Mwa! Kuligaiwa. Bwaina wala yoku kumapu. Yeigu gala ibodi bamapu, paila litugwa gala biyosisi kasi bigukeya kwabila makubilana.”

E omitibogwa wa yam makwaisina kidamwa mina Isireli bimapwaisi kaina bikatumapwaisi avaka, bogwa bivagaisi makawala kasi gulogula. Taitala togimwala bivilili katubukolela kaikela e bisaiki sola. E makawala goli bivigimkulovi vavagi makwaina. Paila baisa kasi gulogula mina Isireli bivitububotaisi kidamwa vavagi makwaina bogwa leivigimkulovaisi wala.
E mapaila tutala matauna iluki Bwasa, kawala, “Bukumapu paila titoulem,” e ivilili katubukolela kaikela isaiki Bwasa.

E Bwasa iluki matausina kaidadala valu deli komwaidosi availa availa itotusi, kawala, “Tauwau. Yokomi komwaidomi ibodaimi bukusolasi kidamwa yam lagaila bogwa lamapu baisa Naomi vavagi komwaidona metoya baisa Elimeleki, deli litula Kilioni sola Maloni.
Tuvaila minana Ruti vilela Mowabi, Maloni kubuyala, minawena bogwa lavakouli ulo kwava. E kwabila baisa paila tokwaliga litula bitetila bilokaia odalela deli ola valu. Yokomi bukusolasi lagaila ke?”

E matausina kaidadala valu deli tomota ikaibigasi, “Bwaina, bakasolasi. Ibodi Guyau bivigaki m kwava makawala minasina Yekobe la kukova, Retieli sola Lea. Paila minasina eiunaisi gugwadi saina bidubadu. Ibodaim bogwa bukubani m guguwa bidubadu baisa odalela Eparati, e bisim kam yeiwau mina Bedeliem omitasi.
Ibodi Guyau bisakaim litumwa metoya baisa minana natubovau, kidamwa bidalasi makawala litula Peresi,
matauwena Yuda sola Tamara litusi.”
Bwasa deli tubula liliusi
E Bwasa ivakouli Ruti ilosi ola bwala, e ivigaki minana la kwava. E Guyau imitukwaii minana e isuma iuni latula tau.
Minasina nunumoya ilukwaisi Naomi, kawasi, “Tayakawolaisi Guyau, paila lagaila isakaim tabum tau e tuta oluvi biyamataim. Ibodi matauna gwadi yagala bikaligiaki mapilana Isireli.

Yawam saina iyebwailim. Ka, kidamwa litumwa biboda tailima taiyu e kaina bukubani pilasi, mitaga minana saina isiligaga, kadai! E tuta baisa eisakaim tabum tau, e magudina biyotitauwaim om tuta numoya.”
Naomi ilupi magudina gwadi e ikipituki vitakola e ilau iyamati.
Minasina sala nunumoya ivabwaisi magudina yagala Obedi. E ilukwaisi tomota komwaidona kawasi, “Naomi bogwa ibani latula tau.” E Obedi latula matauna yagala Yese, e Yese latula matauna Debida.
Baisa liliusi madilana metoya Peresi e bilokaia baisa Debida. Baisa makawala. Peresi, Esironi, Ram, Aminadaba, Nasoni, Salimoni, Bwasa, Obedi, Yese, e Debida.

footnotes.text: Omitibogwa makubilana Emeleki la pwaipwaia, e eisakaili Maloni. E mina Isireli kasi gulogula kidamwa Ruti bivalulu, tomota bidokaisi magudina bisakaili biyosi kala bigukeya goli.
Matauna Bwasa tabula tokinabogwa; kugisi Vit 38.1-30.
